message: `effect(io, unsafe)` on `comma` names 2 effects, and an `effect(...)` tag names one
label: one effect per `effect(...)` tag
notes: a list here was read as ONE effect spelled with the comma in it, which nothing declares - so the claim could never be satisfied, and AX3010 reported it missing from a body that performed it. `restrict(...)` takes a comma list; `effect(...)` does not
help: write one tag line per effect: `;@axiom:effect(io)` and `;@axiom:effect(unsafe)`
